description: This file defines data structures, macros, and function prototypes related to web configuration metadata, including supplementary documents and sub-document support mapping.

classes.name: SupplementaryDocs_t
classes.description: Structure representing a supplementary document with a name and a linked list pointer.

classes.name: SubDocSupportMap_t
classes.description: Structure representing support information for a sub-document, including support flags and optional rbus listener and destination info.

methods.name: set_global_sdInfoHead
methods.description: Sets the global head of the SubDocSupportMap linked list.

methods.name: set_global_sdInfoTail
methods.description: Sets the global tail of the SubDocSupportMap linked list.

methods.name: set_global_spInfoHead
methods.description: Sets the global head of the SupplementaryDocs linked list.

methods.name: set_global_spInfoTail
methods.description: Sets the global tail of the SupplementaryDocs linked list.

methods.name: get_global_sdInfoHead
methods.description: Retrieves the global head of the SubDocSupportMap linked list.

methods.name: get_global_sdInfoTail
methods.description: Retrieves the global tail of the SubDocSupportMap linked list.

methods.name: get_global_spInfoTail
methods.description: Retrieves the global tail of the SupplementaryDocs linked list.

methods.name: isSubDocSupported
methods.description: Checks if a sub-document is supported.

methods.name: isRbusListener
methods.description: Determines if an RBus listener is enabled for a sub-document.

methods.name: get_destination
methods.description: Gets the destination for a sub-document.

methods.name: initWebcfgProperties
methods.description: Initializes web configuration properties from a file.

methods.name: setsupportedDocs
methods.description: Sets the supported documents list.

methods.name: setsupportedVersion
methods.description: Sets the supported version.

methods.name: setsupplementaryDocs
methods.description: Sets the supplementary documents list.

methods.name: getsupportedDocs
methods.description: Retrieves the supported documents list.

methods.name: getsupportedVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the supported version.

methods.name: getsupplementaryDocs
methods.description: Retrieves the supplementary documents list.

methods.name: supplementaryDocs
methods.description: Handles supplementary documents processing.

methods.name: delete_supplementary_list
methods.description: Deletes the supplementary documents list.

methods.name: displaystruct
methods.description: Displays internal data structures.

methods.name: get_global_spInfoHead
methods.description: Retrieves the global head of the supplementary documents list.

methods.name: isSupplementaryDoc
methods.description: Checks if a document is supplementary.
